info.name: Fuel Economy Web Services Emissions Vehicles API

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric vehicle identifier assigned by the EPA/FuelEconomy.gov. Obtain IDs via the /vehicle/menu/options endpoint.

items.docs: Returns full EPA fuel economy record for a specific vehicle including city, highway, and combined MPG ratings, CO2 tailpipe emissions, annual fuel cost estimates, engine specifications, transmission, drive type, vehicle class, and SmartWay scores.
